name: vertexai-stream
purpose: VERTEXAI streams: the route must produce a complete parsed event sequence through the shared Google path, which the source shares with makersuite but reaches through a different literal and a different URL shape (`:streamGenerateContent` plus `&alt=sse`). Until this scenario vertexai had three captures and every one of them was non-streaming, so nothing recorded whether its stream arm sets alt=sse, forwards the parsed events and terminates.
stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.

tier2.reason: The mock listens on an ephemeral loopback port, so the authority is not a property of either backend.
tier2.harnessSource: tools/mock-provider/main.go: --port 0 asks the kernel for a free port, so the authority is not stable

tier2.rule: the recorder origin is replaced with <mock>
tier2.reason: The host is a pinned literal and this drive sets no reverse_proxy, so the pinned leg reaches the recorder through the probe transport redirect and the Go leg through its seam. The PATH, the `:streamGenerateContent` method and the `alt=sse` query are untouched and ARE compared; only the ephemeral authority is rewritten.

tier3.reason: It is a measurement of elapsed wall-clock time, so it differs on every run and no backend can match it; the value is a duration, not a contract.
